item.title: Regulatory and FDA Policy
item.description:
• Summary: This theme covers a range of U.S. regulatory and FDA policy developments. Key stories include the Supreme Court's decision to preserve access to the abortion pill mifepristone, speculation about the next FDA commissioner with biopharma leaders rallying behind Dr. Richard Pazdur, and the FDA floating a potential approach to repurpose approved drugs for new uses. Additionally, there is news about Kyle Diamantas departing the FDA for biotech. These articles reflect broader industry and political dynamics affecting drug regulation and approval pathways.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: STAT News, STAT News, Fierce Pharma, BioSpace, Fierce Pharma, STAT News

item.title: Industry Hiring and Layoffs
item.description:
• Summary: BioSpace reports that 17 companies are hiring in California, and the overall hiring outlook on BioSpace has risen year-over-year, yet layoffs continue to affect thousands of workers in the biopharma industry.
